Market entry brief

The brief answers one question: should we enter this market in the next 18 months, and how.

Open with a Recommendation section: go, no-go, or conditional go, with the condition.
Size the market with a Market size section giving TAM, SAM and SOM, each with its source.
Include a table with the columns Segment, Buyers, Annual spend, Our fit.
Include a Competitors section naming the incumbents and how they sell.
Every figure must cite a source from the material.
State the regulatory constraints in a Regulation section.
Name the two or three things that would change the recommendation.
End with a Next steps section with owners and dates.
